name: Psychological pain — Visions of the Oak

system.description: Apply after a failed Psyche Situation roll (base value 8). The victim suffers −3 to all Skill and Situation rolls until the end of the day. Physical damage is independent of the resistance result.
system.summary: Pain hinders tests after failed resistance.
